harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a NAT/egress gateway for node2 and node3 (Alpine), entirely via an Ansible playbook run from node4 (the pre-installed control node): node1's eth0 (10.100.7.10/24, shared with node2/node3) got a static IP, a default route to the platform gateway (10.100.7.1), and a source-NAT masquerade rule for 10.100.7.0/24 outbound eth0; node2/node3's dhcpcd config was overridden to route their default gateway through node1 instead of the platform gateway directly. Verified via conntrack/nftables counters that node2/node3 traffic is genuinely translated through node1, then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming boot-id changes and full recovery of NAT, routing, and Ansible/SSH connectivity after each restart.
actions_performed: Surveyed all 4 nodes' interfaces/routes; identified node1=VyOS router, node2/node3=Alpine LAN clients on 10.100.7.0/24, node4=Ubuntu Ansible control node
Diagnosed that node1's eth0 needed a static LAN IP (10.100.7.10/24) since DHCP gave no offer there; eth1 had no usable link and was left unused

Bootstrapped passwordless SSH from node4 to node1 (vyos user) and node2/node3 (root) using the cluster's CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY/PUBKEY; unlocked Alpine's locked root accounts (shadow '!*' -> '*') to permit key-only login; installed python3 on Alpine nodes for Ansible module execution

Wrote and ran /root/nat-egress/site.yml on node4 (inventory.ini) implementing: node1 static IP + default route + NAT source masquerade rule 100 for 10.100.7.0/24 via eth0; node2/node3 dhcpcd.conf override (static routers=10.100.7.10) plus networking restart

Verified NAT operation via nft ruleset counters and conntrack entries showing 10.100.7.11/.12 traffic translated to 10.100.7.10, plus successful curl/ping to 1.1.1.1 from node2/node3 through the new route
Persisted the ansible SSH key into node1's own VyOS config (system login user vyos authentication public-keys) after discovering VyOS regenerates authorized_keys from committed config on boot
Captured pre-restart baselines (boot_id, NAT/route health) on all 4 nodes
Restarted node1, then node2, then node3, then node4 one at a time using native reboot, polling until each reconnected, confirming changed boot_id each time

Re-verified NAT rule persistence, IP forwarding, LAN reachability, and internet egress on node1 after its reboot; re-verified default route and internet reachability on node2/node3 after their reboots; re-ran the full Ansible playbook idempotently (changed=0) from node4 after its own reboot to confirm end-to-end control-plane recovery

evidence.requirement: Proof NAT is actually translating node2/node3 traffic through node1
evidence.summary: conntrack on node1 shows real flows from 10.100.7.11 and 10.100.7.12 SNAT'd to 10.100.7.10 for DNS/NTP/HTTPS traffic

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 reach the internet through node1 (not directly)
evidence.summary: default route on node2/node3 changed to 10.100.7.10 (node1); curl/ping to 1.1.1.1 succeed via that path both before and after their reboots

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered state after restart
evidence.summary: static IP, default route, ip_forward=1, NAT masquerade rule (with live packet counters), and LAN pings to node2/node3 all confirmed post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed to 18e4ed5b... after reconnect

evidence.requirement: node2 recovered state after restart
evidence.summary: default route still via node1 (dhcpcd override persisted), curl/ping to 1.1.1.1 succeed

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed to 367ee270... after reconnect

evidence.requirement: node3 recovered state after restart
evidence.summary: default route still via node1, curl/ping to 1.1.1.1 succeed

evidence.requirement: node4 healthy baseline before restart

evidence.requirement: node4 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed to 1728d8ef... after reconnect

evidence.requirement: node4 recovered state after restart (control-plane recovery)
